problem: Musicians sketching ideas on the move lose them because existing loopers demand two hands, menus, and a desk. Capture-to-loop must be one gesture, and the result must be usable in a real set.

users.goal: capture a 4-bar idea before it evaporates
users.context: on a train, one hand, 20 seconds

users.goal: layer and mute loops on stage without looking
users.context: dim stage, iPad on a stand

scenarios: Recording with headphones in a noisy carriage
Stage: iPad at arm's length, 40 lux

acceptance.criterion: A new loop can be captured in one continuous gesture
All performance controls ≥ 64pt on iPad stage layout
Every screen has designed empty, loading, error and overflow states
